camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of wall and floor patches vs frame 0 <= 0.08 px every frame, see tracks/camera_shift.csv)
camera.view: elevated, looking down-forward onto a carpeted floor of a corridor/room; frame timestamps uniform (1/24 s)

perspective_cues.ground_plane: grey striped carpet fills y~150-720; stripes roughly horizontal
perspective_cues.wall_floor_edge_right: dark baseboard line from about (700,90) to (1280,500) (right wall)
perspective_cues.far_end: table, two people and a tripod at y<200 (far background)

blue_car.description: toy / RC car with a blue cover decorated with white and yellow patches, dark wheels; the only moving object
blue_car.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the full car mask (visible centre); bbox_cx/bbox_cy = bbox centre
blue_car.motion: already moving at frame 0 and still moving at frame 47; drives away from the camera toward the upper-left (towards the far end of the room), roughly straight
blue_car.apparent_size_trend: mask min-area-rect length 159->122 px, width 124->86 px, bbox width 164->123 px from frame 0 to 47: shrinks ~0.75x because it moves away (depth grows ~1.3x)

basketball.note: orange Wilson basketball by the right wall; diameter ~64-69 px (bbox_w 69 includes slight blur; bottom is shaded)

white_cup.note: small white cylindrical cup/can standing on floor, centre-left

white_stick_mid.note: thin white stick/tape strip lying on floor right of the cup; length ~88 px

white_box_card.note: white rectangular box/card lying on floor near bottom centre; ~81 x 77 px

white_stick_bottom.note: white stick at bottom edge, partly cut by frame bottom (length >= 126 px visible)

yellow_bit.note: tiny yellow object on floor (~8 px)

wall_socket_plate.note: small white plate on right wall

people_background.note: two people at the far end (one seated at x~430-560, one standing x~600-670, y 0-195); static during clip; partly cut by the top edge

tripod.note: black tripod at upper left x~130-300, y 0-270

table.note: wooden table/cabinet at upper left x~100-310, y 0-130

white_bag.note: white/blue bag with a tennis ball on the floor at x~330-430, y~110-185

orange_cables.note: red/orange cables along floor at far end and along right wall

events.event: car in motion from the first frame (no start of motion visible)
car still moving at last frame (no stop)
larger-than-neighbour image steps between frames 11->12 and 35->36 (~2x usual); timestamps are uniform so this may be a dropped capture frame or a real jolt
